suspected_ui_regions.reason: The concentric circular floor inlay and gold radial markers weakly resemble a large radial UI dial, although they are clearly integrated into the environment.
Repeated dark platform and stair bands create long bar-like silhouettes near the bottom edge, but perspective and material continuity identify them as architecture rather than composed UI.
